description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/CakeOrders_RawInfo.xlsx containing three custom cake orders with the same weekend deadline. Analyze the baking times, cooling times, decorating times, and delivery deadlines. Create a new sheet called 'Production Timeline' that shows an hour-by-hour production schedule from Thursday through Saturday, working backward from each delivery deadline. Ensure no oven conflicts (only one item can bake at a time), account for cooling time before decorating, and mark sleep windows. Save the spreadsheet as CakeOrders_ProductionTimeline.xlsx.
